description_en: Queries the information about the endpoints of an instance that runs RDS Cluster Edition
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS集群系列实例的Endpoint信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-instance-endpoints --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOC0000 --db-instance-id rm-u0000 --db-instance-endpoint-id ep-0000-ro --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstanceEndpoints

parameters.description_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由ASCII字符组成，最长不超过64个字符，不能包含非ASCII字符。
